name: rpi-mcp-adapter
description: MCP client adapter: single `mcp` proxy tool with lazy server lifecycle — an optional replacement for the built-in MCP extension, sharing the same `mcp.json` layout (port of pi-mcp-adapter @ v4.0.0)
author: revpidev
descriptionZh: MCP 客户端适配器:单个 `mcp` 代理工具与懒连接服务器生命周期——内建 MCP 扩展的可选替换,共享同一 `mcp.json` 配置布局(pi-mcp-adapter @ v4.0.0 移植)。
deprecatedMessage: MCP is now built into rpi (v0.1.6). This extension is no longer updated or packaged; uninstall it with `rpi remove rpi-mcp-adapter` and use the built-in MCP extension.
deprecatedMessageZh: MCP 已内置于 rpi(v0.1.6)。本插件不再更新与发布;请用 `rpi remove rpi-mcp-adapter` 卸载,改用内建 MCP 扩展。
